concerns.text: The task list does not include a concrete step to pin deterministic random seeds in all scripts (e.g., `np.random.seed`, `random.seed`, PyMC `pm.set_data` seed). This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which requires seeds to be pinned in code.

While T018 records hashes for derived files, there is no task that computes and records checksums for the raw poll files downloaded in T006. Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) mandates that every dataset, including raw inputs, be checksummed and logged in the project‑state YAML.
